'''February 2001 Melbourne Sealed Deck tournament (18 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 18 February 2001. It is known from Ronnie Wilcox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1763">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-bastardized-melb-aus-18-2-01d1763/ bastardized-melb-aus-18-2-01], DeckTech (Ronnie "AD-fig" Wilcox, 23 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-bastardized-melb-aus-18-2-01d1763/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
